tsbs.title: Head gasket can leak coolant (warranty extended, CVT)
tsbs.plain_summary: On some 2018-2022 Accords with the 1.5L turbo and CVT automatic, the head gasket can stop sealing well. The engine may run hot, lose coolant or misfire. Honda lengthened the warranty on this part. A Honda dealer checks your VIN to see if it qualifies.

coverage.term: 10 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first

verified.method: Read the NHTSA-filed PDF (static.nhtsa.gov) via WebFetch; NHTSA byNhtsaId API was not reachable from this session

tsbs.title: Hybrid engine software update for engine temperature
tsbs.plain_summary: Honda is updating engine computer software on some 2023-2025 Accord Hybrids. The update changes how the electric water pump runs, to help keep engine temperature in check. Honda planned to start telling owners in September 2026. A dealer can check your VIN.

verified.method: Read the NHTSA-filed PDF (static.nhtsa.gov) via WebFetch; NHTSA byNhtsaId API was not reachable from this session; one dealer notice covers 26-080 (Accord Hybrid), 26-088 (CR-V Hybrid) and 26-089 (Civic Hybrid); it names no symptoms
